Title: Introducing Berth Planner: schedules your whole port can see - Quayside blog

# Introducing Berth Planner

Today we are launching Berth Planner, the scheduling board harbour masters asked us for.
Every berth, every vessel and every tide window on one screen, updated the moment a
booking changes.

Berth Planner is built on the same public API our customers use, so anything you see on the
board you can also fetch from your own systems: berth schedules, vessel details and tide
windows. Planning teams at three of Europe's ten busiest container ports have used it
through the beta, and moved an average of 40 minutes of daily coordination off the phone.

Berth Planner is included in every Quayside plan from today. Read the API documentation to
connect your own tools.
